title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.01531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. translated_title: 迈向可靠的自动驾驶视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型正越来越多地被应用于自动驾驶领域，用于场景理解、驾驶推理、决策制定和端到端驾驶等任务。随着其作用日益突出，确保其鲁棒性和可靠性变得越来越重要。在现实世界条件下，视觉输入可能因传感器缺陷和环境条件而退化，进而影响模型预测及其相关置信度。这种退化在自动驾驶中尤其令人担忧，因为安全关键的决策要求模型不仅要做出准确预测，还要能够识别其预测何时可能不可靠。在这项工作中，我们在四个与驾驶相关的问答数据集上评估了五种视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B 和 NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），并采用了不同的视觉输入设置，包括单帧、多视角、多帧和单目
tldr: 该论文系统评估了五种视觉语言模型在多种视觉输入退化条件下的自动驾驶问答任务中的可靠性与鲁棒性表现。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates five vision-language models for their reliability and robustness in autonomous driving QA tasks under various degraded visual input conditions.
